description: Known-issues ledger for the scheduled watchdog workflows. Holds the durable triage knowledge the daily ops digest compares against: fetch channels, steady-state baselines, known-issue classifications, and closed-incident history. Volatile daily numbers (for example the rest-upstream drift substantiveCount/diffDigest series) intentionally live in a local state file outside the repository; only rules, statuses, and thresholds belong here.

statusSemantics.known-expected: Appears in healthy runs; do not report unless it disappears or worsens.
statusSemantics.watch: Low-level signal under observation; report only trend changes.
statusSemantics.in-progress: Tracked follow-up with a named owner/path; report status changes.
statusSemantics.resolved: Closed; reopen as a new issue if it reappears.

producerNote: translate-codex.yml deliberately stays off docs-production-dev in standalone mode; it publishes through the short-lock publisher (publish-translation.yml), so a running producer does not by itself mean the production queue is occupied.

fetching.runWindow: Enumerate with gh run list --workflow <file> --created "<yesterday>T00:00:00+08:00..<today>T00:00:00+08:00"; convert the dates for the run day.
fetching.listByWorkflowFile: Always filter by workflow file name, never display name: display-name casing churned during the 2026-10 renaming (#889).
fetching.failedRunLogs: gh run view <id> --log-failed; when logs return BlobNotFound, fall back to gh run view <id> for job-level failed steps.
fetching.artifacts: gh run download <id> --dir <tmp-dir> then read the report files.
fetching.spaShellTrap: Judge page liveness by <title>, not status codes alone; curl needs --compressed (responses are gzip-encoded). Unknown-path behavior differs per site — the en site returns a real HTTP 404 with a Page Not Found title — so verify per site before relying on the status code.

watchdogs.fetchDetail: No artifact; scheduled runs set FEISHU_NOTIFICATIONS_DISABLED=true and skip report-card. The only channel is the job log: gh api repos/zilliztech/zdoc/actions/jobs/<jobId>/logs --allow-escape-sequences, strip ANSI, then grep 'Broken links:|Broken anchors:' and the 'Broken link on source page path' / 'linking to' detail lines.

watchdogs.fetchDetail: Conclusion plus ok flag; verify/aggregate job presence within 24h.

watchdogs.fetchDetail: Only failed runs matter: download the artifact and read realFailures. Do not trust conclusion alone.
watchdogs.steadyState: Real failures are either already-merged PR history or transient zero-job startup faults the watchdog itself re-runs.

knownIssues.symptom: realFailures naming a pull_request run whose PR is already merged.
knownIssues.classification: Historical run of a merged PR; resolved by definition.

watchdogs.fetchDetail: Historically the job succeeds even while drift is present, so the drift signal lives in the artifact rest-upstream-drift-<run_id> (retained 14 days): read watchdog-report.json for sources[].status (no-drift|drift), substantiveCount, summary categories, and diffDigest. A failed conclusion is itself report-worthy (first observed 2026-10-31, run 41168026117).
watchdogs.steadyState: Both sources drift while upstream moves faster than refreshes land; the digest tracks the day-over-day substantiveCount/diffDigest series and the unattributed counts in the local state file, never in this ledger.

watchdogs.fetchDetail: Weekly report artifact plus Feishu card; per-event totals and GA4 key-event counts per site. On non-Mondays there is no run by design.
watchdogs.steadyState: The signal to watch is an event whose count stays 0 across runs — that means the instrumentation or its GTM trigger went quiet.
